dict.Lag et API-token for statistikk: Create an API token for statistics
dict.Tokenet gir Homelab lesetilgang til traf: The token gives Homelab read access to traffic, DNS, security and the expiry date of the domain. It cannot change anything in Cloudflare.
dict.Logg inn på dash.cloudflare.com. Trykk p: Log in to dash.cloudflare.com. Click the profile icon at the top right → “My Profile” → “API Tokens”.
dict.Trykk «Create Token». Bla ned til «Custo: Click “Create Token”. Scroll down to “Custom token” and click “Get started”. Do not use the Global API Key.
dict.Skriv for eksempel «Homelab statistikk»: Type for example “Homelab statistics” in “Token name”.
dict.Under «Permissions»: trykk «+ Add more»: Under “Permissions”: click “+ Add more” for each line. All should be “Read”.
dict.Under «Zone Resources»: Include → Specif: Under “Zone Resources”: Include → Specific zone → choose your domain. Under “Account Resources”: Include → your account (needed for the expiry date).
dict.Trykk «Continue to summary» → «Create To: Click “Continue to summary” → “Create Token”. Copy the token right away, it is only shown once.
The token is only shown once in Cloudflare. Paste it into the “API token” field and click “Test token”. Homelab stores it encrypted on the server, never in the browser.
dict.Serveren kan ikke teste tokenet ennå. Op: The server cannot test the token yet. Update Homelab.
Sign out is always at the bottom.
dict.Logge ut? Denne enheten må da logge inn: Sign out? This device will need to sign in with a password again.
You can use the app while it updates.
dict.Alt kjører. Endringene er aktive i appen: Everything is running. The changes are active in the app and on the web.
dict.Du finner oppdateringen i Innstillinger: You can find the update in Settings → System
dict.Updateren installerer forrige vellykkede: The updater reinstalls the previous successful version. Your data is kept (the backup from before the update is not restored automatically).
dict.Det tas backup først. Serveren starter p: A backup is taken first. The server restarts, which usually takes 2–5 minutes. You can use the app meanwhile.
dict.Banner på Dashboard og push til administ: Banner on the Dashboard and push to administrators.

dict.Kvitteringen mangler posisjoner for linj: The receipt has no line positions. Read it again to highlight in the image.
